title: Crystalsong Forest
body: Crystalsong Forest lies at the heart of Northrend, its trees crystal from root to leaf and its woods glittering in shades of gold and russet. In ages past night elves dwelt here at Shandaral, and their spirits have never left, while in the east strange beings steeped in magic, called the Unbound, haunt the thicket. Above the western woods floats Dalaran, and the Silver Covenant and the Sunreavers each keep a camp, facing one another across the old ruins.

title: The Violet Stand
body: The Violet Stand is the Kirin Tor's foothold on the forest floor beneath the edge of Dalaran, where warmages stand fixed at their posts channeling their power without rest into the shield that guards it, and a crystal carries travelers up to the city. The guard is not for show: just to the southeast the blue dragonflight holds the Azure Front, drawing on whatever power the forest holds.

title: Ruins of Shandaral
body: The Ruins of Shandaral lie in the east of the forest: broken walls of a night elf settlement from ages past, whose spirits still keep watch, warriors, druids and hunters with spectral wolves, striking at every living intruder as though the town still needed defending. The Unbound prowl around them, every creature of the thicket holding a core of crystallized energy, and the lost spirits of Shandaral wander as far as the Forlorn Woods.
